# `{sdlegviz}`

Networks of how South Dakota legislators vote and sponsor bills together, from
OpenStates roll calls and the SD Legislature's member records.

## Run

```{r, eval = FALSE}
golem::run_dev() # or source("dev/run_dev.R")
```

## Data

`source("data-raw/process_data.R")` rebuilds the app's data in `inst/extdata`
from the raw OpenStates data, set by `BASE_PATH` in `.env`.

## Deploy

See `dev/03_deploy.R`.
